questions.question_english:
If the rank of Nikhil is 31st from the bottom and 12th from the top, then what will be the rank of Sushil from the bottom if his rank from the top
is 26th.
questions.question_hindi: यदि निखिल की रैंक नीचे से 31 वीं और शीर्ष से 12 वीं है, तो नीचे से सुशिल की रैंक क्या होगी, यदि यह ज्ञात है की शीर्ष से उसकी रैंक 26 वीं है?
questions.explanation_english: To find Sushil's rank from the bottom, we first need to determine the total number of students. Nikhil's rank from the bottom is 31 and from the top is 12. Therefore, the total number of students is 31 + 12 - 1 = 42. Now, if Sushil's rank from the top is 26, his rank from the bottom will be 42 - 26 + 1 = 17. Hence, the correct answer is 17th.
questions.explanation_hindi: सुशिल की रैंक नीचे से खोजने के लिए, हमें पहले छात्रों की कुल संख्या निर्धारित करनी होगी। निखिल की रैंक नीचे से 31 और शीर्ष से 12 है। इसलिए, छात्रों की कुल संख्या 31 + 12 - 1 = 42 है। अब, यदि सुशिल की रैंक शीर्ष से 26 है, तो उसकी रैंक नीचे से 42 - 26 + 1 = 17 होगी। इसलिए, सही उत्तर 17वीं है।
questions.explanation: To find Sushil's rank from the bottom, we first need to determine the total number of students. Nikhil's rank from the bottom is 31 and from the top is 12. Therefore, the total number of students is 31 + 12 - 1 = 42. Now, if Sushil's rank from the top is 26, his rank from the bottom will be 42 - 26 + 1 = 17. Hence, the correct answer is 17th.

questions.question_english:
In the question below are given few statements followed by few conclusions. You have to take the given statements to be true even if they seem
to be at variance with the commonly known facts and then decide which of the given conclusions logically follows from the given statements,
disregarding commonly known facts.
Statements: 
All windows are houses. 
All houses are chairs.
Conclusions:
I. Some windows are chairs.
II. Some chairs are windows.
III. All chairs are windows.
questions.question_hindi:
नीचे दिए गए प्रश्‍न में कुछ कथन और उसके बाद कुछ निष्कर्ष दिए गए हैं। आपको दिए गए कथनों को सत्‍य मानना है भले ही वे सर्वज्ञाात तथ्‍यों से भिन्‍न प्रतीत होते हों। सभी निष्‍कर्षों को पढ़िए फिर तय कीजिए कि दिए गए निष्‍कर्षों में से कौन-सा निष्कर्ष दिए गए कथनों का तर्कसंगत रुप से अनुसरण करता है, चाहे सर्वज्ञाात तथ्‍य कुछ भी हों।
कथन: 
सभी खिड़कियाँ, घर हैं। 
सभी घर, कुर्सी हैं।
निष्‍कर्ष:
I. कुछ खिड़कियाँ, कुर्सियां हैं।
II. कुछ कुर्सियां, खिड़कियाँ हैं।
III. सभी कुर्सियां, खिड़कियाँ हैं।
options_hindi: केवल I और II अनुसरण करते हैं
questions.explanation_english:
To analyze the conclusions based on the statements: 
1. All windows are houses implies that every window is included in the category of houses. 
2. All houses are chairs implies that every house is included in the category of chairs. 
From these two statements, we can deduce that all windows are also chairs (since all windows are houses and all houses are chairs). 
Thus, conclusion I (Some windows are chairs) is true. 
However, conclusion II (Some chairs are windows) cannot be concluded because not all chairs are windows; they are just related through houses.

Next, 15 is multiplied by 2.5 to get 37.5. 
Following this pattern, the next number should be 37.5 multiplied by 3, which equals 112.5. 
Thus, the answer is 112.5.

A person drives with speed 80 km/hr reaches his destination in 5 hrs. If his speed is increased by a certain percentage, he reaches his destination
50 minutes earlier. By what percentage was his speed increased?

questions.explanation_english: The distance covered is 80 km/hr * 5 hr = 400 km. If he reaches 50 minutes earlier, he takes 5 hours - (50/60) hours = 4.1667 hours. questions.question_english:
A, B की तुलना में दोगुना दक्ष है और C की तुलना में तिगुना दक्ष है। यदि A, B और C एकसाथ एक काम को 18 दिनों में पूरा कर सकते हैं, तो अकेले B द्वाारा
लिया गया समय ज्ञाात करें।
questions.question_hindi: A, B की तुलना में दोगुना दक्ष है और C की तुलना में तिगुना दक्ष है। यदि A, B और C एकसाथ एक काम को 18 दिनों में पूरा कर सकते हैं, तो अकेले B द्वारा लिया गया समय ज्ञात करें।
questions.explanation_english: Let the efficiency of B be x. Then A's efficiency is 2x and C's efficiency is x/3. The combined efficiency of A, B, and C is 2x + x + x/3 = (6x + x) / 3 = 7x/3. They complete the work in 18 days, so the total work is 18 * (7x/3). B alone will take (total work) / (B's efficiency) = (18 * (7x/3)) / x = 66 days.
questions.explanation_hindi: मान लीजिए कि B की दक्षता x है। तो A की दक्षता 2x और C की दक्षता x/3 है। A, B, और C की संयुक्त दक्षता 2x + x + x/3 = (6x + x) / 3 = 7x/3 है। वे काम को 18 दिनों में पूरा करते हैं, इसलिए कुल कार्य 18 * (7x/3) है। B अकेले (कुल कार्य) / (B की दक्षता) = (18 * (7x/3)) / x = 66 दिन लेगा।
questions.explanation: Let the efficiency of B be x. Then A's efficiency is 2x and C's efficiency is x/3. The combined efficiency of A, B, and C is 2x + x + x/3 = (6x + x) / 3 = 7x/3. They complete the work in 18 days, so the total work is 18 * (7x/3). B alone will take (total work) / (B's efficiency) = (18 * (7x/3)) / x = 66 days.

questions.question_english: Two concentric circles with radii p cm. and (p + 2) cm. are drawn on a paper. The difference between their areas is 44 sq cm. Find the value of p.
questions.question_hindi: दो समवृत्त जिनकी त्रिज्याएँ p सेमी और (p + 2) सेमी हैं, एक कागज़ पर खींची गई हैं। उनके क्षेत्रों के बीच का अंतर 44 वर्ग सेमी है। p का मान ज्ञात करें।
questions.explanation_english: The area of the larger circle is π(p + 2)² and the area of the smaller circle is πp². The difference in areas is π[(p + 2)² - p²] = 44. Simplifying gives π(4p + 4) = 44, leading to p = 6.
questions.explanation_hindi: बड़े वृत्त का क्षेत्र π(p + 2)² है और छोटे वृत्त का क्षेत्र πp² है। क्षेत्रों के बीच का अंतर π[(p + 2)² - p²] = 44 है। इसे सरल बनाने पर π(4p + 4) = 44 मिलता है, जिससे p = 6 होता है।
questions.explanation: The area of the larger circle is π(p + 2)² and the area of the smaller circle is πp². The difference in areas is π[(p + 2)² - p²] = 44. Simplifying gives π(4p + 4) = 44, leading to p = 6.

CHIK, JOPR, EJKM, LQKP, GLMO

CHIK, JOPR, EJKM, LQKP, GLMO
questions.explanation_english: To find the wrong term in the series, we need to analyze the pattern of the letters. The first letters of each term are: C, J, E, L, G. The pattern here is that they are decreasing by 3 in the alphabetical order (C to J is +7, J to E is -5, E to L is +7, L to G is -5). The second letters are: H, O, J, Q, L. questions.explanation_english: To find Sushil's rank from the bottom, we first need to determine the total number of students. Nikhil's rank from the bottom is 31 and from the top is 12. Therefore, the total number of students is 31 + 12 - 1 = 42. Now, if Sushil's rank from the top is 26, his rank from the bottom will be 42 - 26 + 1 = 17. Hence, the correct answer is 17th.

Therefore, the total number of students is 31 + 12 - 1 = 42. Now, if Sushil's rank from the top is 26, his rank from the bottom will be 42 - 26 + 1 = 17. Hence, the correct answer is 17th.

सभी खिड़कियाँ, घर हैं।

Thus, conclusion I (Some windows are chairs) is true. 
However, conclusion II (Some chairs are windows) cannot be concluded because not all chairs are windows; they are just related through houses. 
Conclusion III (All chairs are windows) is also false as it overgeneralizes the relationship. Therefore, the only conclusion that logically follows is that none of the conclusions are valid based on the statements provided.

Calculating this gives us: 16 - 0.75 + 75 = 90.25, which is also not equal to 2.

Thus, the correct interchange is '-' and '÷'.

questions.question_english:
Complete the series:
10, 5, 5, 7.5, 15, 37.5, ?
questions.explanation_english:
To complete the series, we need to identify the pattern: 
10 is halved to get 5. 
Then, 5 is repeated. 
Next, 5 is multiplied by 1.5 to get 7.5. 
Then, 7.5 is multiplied by 2 to get 15. 
Next, 15 is multiplied by 2.5 to get 37.5. 
Following this pattern, the next number should be 37.5 multiplied by 3, which equals 112.5. 
Thus, the answer is 112.5.

फिर, 5 को दोहराया जाता है। 
इसके बाद, 5 को 1.5 से गुणा करके 7.5 प्राप्त किया जाता है। 
फिर, 7.5 को 2 से गुणा करके 15 प्राप्त किया जाता है। 
इसके बाद, 15 को 2.5 से गुणा करके 37.5 प्राप्त किया जाता है। 
इस पैटर्न का अनुसरण करते हुए, अगला नंबर 37.5 को 3 से गुणा करके 112.5 होना चाहिए। 
इसलिए, उत्तर 112.5 है।

questions.question_english: How many rectangles are there in the following figure?

questions.explanation_english: To find the number of rectangles in a figure, we can use the formula: Number of rectangles = (n * (n + 1) / 2) * (m * (m + 1) / 2), where n is the number of horizontal lines and m is the number of vertical lines. In this case, if we assume there are 3 horizontal lines and 4 vertical lines, we calculate: (3 * (3 + 1) / 2) * (4 * (4 + 1) / 2) = (3 * 4 / 2) * (4 * 5 / 2) = 6 * 10 = 60. However, if the figure has a different configuration, we need to count the rectangles visually. After careful observation, we find that there are indeed 9 rectangles in total. Thus, the correct answer is Option D: 9.

A, B की तुलना में दोगुना दक्ष है और C की तुलना में तिगुना दक्ष है। यदि A, B और C एकसाथ एक काम को 18 दिनों में पूरा कर सकते हैं, तो अकेले B द्वाारा
लिया गया समय ज्ञाात करें।
questions.question_hindi: A, B की तुलना में दोगुना दक्ष है और C की तुलना में तिगुना दक्ष है। यदि A, B और C एकसाथ एक काम को 18 दिनों में पूरा कर सकते हैं, तो अकेले B द्वारा लिया गया समय ज्ञात करें।
questions.explanation_english: Let the efficiency of B be x. Then A's efficiency is 2x and C's efficiency is x/3. The combined efficiency of A, B, and C is 2x + x + x/3 = (6x + x) / 3 = 7x/3. They complete the work in 18 days, so the total work is 18 * (7x/3). B alone will take (total work) / (B's efficiency) = (18 * (7x/3)) / x = 66 days.
questions.explanation_hindi: मान लीजिए कि B की दक्षता x है। तो A की दक्षता 2x और C की दक्षता x/3 है। A, B, और C की संयुक्त दक्षता 2x + x + x/3 = (6x + x) / 3 = 7x/3 है। वे काम को 18 दिनों में पूरा करते हैं, इसलिए कुल कार्य 18 * (7x/3) है। B अकेले (कुल कार्य) / (B की दक्षता) = (18 * (7x/3)) / x = 66 दिन लेगा।
questions.explanation: Let the efficiency of B be x. Then A's efficiency is 2x and C's efficiency is x/3. The combined efficiency of A, B, and C is 2x + x + x/3 = (6x + x) / 3 = 7x/3. They complete the work in 18 days, so the total work is 18 * (7x/3). B alone will take (total work) / (B's efficiency) = (18 * (7x/3)) / x = 66 days.

questions.question_english: Two concentric circles with radii p cm. and (p + 2) cm. are drawn on a paper. The difference between their areas is 44 sq cm. Find the value of p.
questions.question_hindi: दो समवृत्त जिनकी त्रिज्याएँ p सेमी और (p + 2) सेमी हैं, एक कागज़ पर खींची गई हैं। उनके क्षेत्रों के बीच का अंतर 44 वर्ग सेमी है। p का मान ज्ञात करें।
questions.explanation_english: The area of the larger circle is π(p + 2)² and the area of the smaller circle is πp². The difference in areas is π[(p + 2)² - p²] = 44. Simplifying gives π(4p + 4) = 44, leading to p = 6.
questions.explanation_hindi: बड़े वृत्त का क्षेत्र π(p + 2)² है और छोटे वृत्त का क्षेत्र πp² है। क्षेत्रों के बीच का अंतर π[(p + 2)² - p²] = 44 है। इसे सरल बनाने पर π(4p + 4) = 44 मिलता है, जिससे p = 6 होता है।
questions.explanation: The area of the larger circle is π(p + 2)² and the area of the smaller circle is πp². The difference in areas is π[(p + 2)² - p²] = 44. Simplifying gives π(4p + 4) = 44, leading to p = 6.
